subject: Redwood x Greenfield — customer spotlight and logo license request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sara Whitmore <sara.whitmore@greenfieldlabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood x Greenfield — customer spotlight and logo license request

Hi Sara,

Hope you are well. We wrapped a short customer spotlight draft based on our work together and would love to publish a 1-page case study and a short web feature highlighting Greenfield Labs. The draft is attached for your review.

What we are asking for:
- Permission to display the Greenfield Labs logo on the case study landing page and the downloadable PDF.
- A short approved quote (1-2 lines) from someone on your product or GTM team; we suggested a line in the draft but happy to swap in whatever you prefer.
- Confirmation of any usage restrictions (regions, duration, channels).

Attached: redwood_draft_case_study_v1.pdf (draft content and suggested quote). We also included a proposed signature page for legal to sign if everything looks good.

If possible, could you share feedback or an approval by end of week? We can narrow the scope to web + PDF only if you prefer.

Thanks so much — excited to tell this story.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_draft_case_study_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

From: Sara Whitmore <sara.whitmore@greenfieldlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenfield Legal <legal@greenfieldlabs.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x Greenfield — customer spotlight and logo license request

Hi Ben,

Thanks for sending this over and for making the draft concise. The team likes the narrative — great job capturing the outcomes. I looped in Legal to review the licensing language and our brand team attached the standard logo lockup and usage guidance.

A couple of quick notes from product/PR:
- The suggested quote is fine but we would prefer it to read slightly more technical; I put an edit in the attached draft.
- We would be comfortable with web and PDF distribution, and a short social announcement if Redwood provides the copy for review ahead of posting.

Legal will confirm the term and sign-off. Laura, Ben: legal may ask for a two-year term and a signed release form. I can expedite on our side.

Best,
Sara Whitmore
Head of Partnerships, Greenfield Labs
sara.whitmore@greenfieldlabs.com
[Attachment: greenfield_brand_guidelines.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Whitmore <sara.whitmore@greenfieldlabs.com>
Date: 2026-04-13T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood x Greenfield — customer spotlight and logo license request

Laura / Dev,

Looping you both in since Greenfield legal is on copy and they may request a standard two-year term plus a signed permission form. Attached is their brand guidelines and my updated case study (I accepted Sara's suggested tweak to the quote).

Can you confirm:
1) Is the attached signature page we proposed sufficient from our side, or should legal redline?
2) Any concerns with a two-year license for web + PDF + optional social (with pre-approval)?
3) If approved, I will send the final assets to Sara and include the logo files and copy for the social post.

Quick note: Greenfield is part of the GF-2249 renewal conversation; a published case study will help the Q3 renewal motion.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_draft_case_study_v1.pdf (updated, PDF, 1.3MB)]

From: Greenfield Legal <legal@greenfieldlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Whitmore <sara.whitmore@greenfieldlabs.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-14T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x Greenfield — customer spotlight and logo license request

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the materials. Greenfield Legal has reviewed the draft and approves the use of the Greenfield Labs name, logo, and the edited quote under the following conditions:

1) Permitted channels: Redwood website case study landing page, downloadable PDF, and one scheduled social post on Redwood channels.
2) Term: two years from the date of publication, after which permission must be renewed in writing.
3) No implication of endorsement beyond the factual case study; language implying product endorsement must be removed.
4) Logo must be used only in the provided lockups and must respect the attached brand guidance.

We have attached a signed permission form for your records. Please retain a copy of the signed release. If you need any minor edits to the signature page, let us know and we will countersign.

Signed,
Greenfield Labs Legal Team
legal@greenfieldlabs.com
[Attachment: greenfield_signed_release.pdf (PDF, signed)]
